tools.name: wheel_spacer_calculator
tools.description: Use for "do I need spacers", "what spacer gets +35 wheels to +20", "is a 10 mm slip-on spacer safe". A spacer lowers the effective offset by its thickness. Returns the spacer needed for a target offset (and the nearest common size), the effective offset, track change, whether it is slip-on or bolt-o
